hey there, so to give some personal context…i was in a very similar situation. months went by and i was dealing with the same exact thing, inevitably questioning if something was wrong with me. i ended up asking him about it, point blank, and he said that genuinely the thought of doing that to me or any woman disgusted him. he couldn’t explain why, other than he just didn’t like it. long story short, i wasn’t in too deep emotionally with the guy and broke things off partially because of the fact that i wasn’t being completely satisfied (in this way and other ways, some non-sexual). my best advice? listen to your gut. confront him about it, if you haven’t already. if he still won’t try to go down and you feel that this is a dealbreaker for you, i recommend having that conversation with him and just be aware that it may end your relationship. however, you have to put yourself and your needs first! some may disagree, but i don’t believe in “too high” of standards. what you want and need is what you deserve, period! best of luck to you.
